  have h_main : ((a : α) → β₁ a) ≃ ((a : α) → β₂ a) := by
    refine' ⟨fun f => fun a => (F a).1 (f a), fun g => fun a => (F a).2 (g a), ?_, ?_⟩
    · -- Prove that the backward function is the inverse of the forward function
      intro f
